entries.question: All ditels kgmu
entries.answer:
King George's Medical University (KGMU), located in Chowk, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, was founded in 1905. It is one of India's premier medical institutions, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and super-specialty medical and dental programs, alongside comprehensive patient care.

### Key Overview
- **Founded:** 1905
- **Location:** Chowk, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India
- **Main Website:** [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)

### Patient Care & OPD Services
- **Online Registration:** Mandatory via [ORS Government Portal](https://ors.gov.in) or health care apps.
- **Helpline Numbers:** 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333
- **SMS Appointment:** Send `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` to 8887019134.
- **OPD Slip Fee:** ₹50 across all booking methods.
- **Timings:** Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM–12:00 PM; closed on Sundays.

### Important Portals & Links
- **Admissions:** [Courses Admission](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)
- **Departments:** [Department Directory](https://www.kgmu.org/department.php)
- **Examination Results:** [Examination Results](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_result/examination_result.php)
- **Notice Board:** [Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php)
- **Exam Scheme:** [Exam Scheme](https://kgmu.org/exam_scheme.php)

If you are looking for specific information regarding departments, faculty members, tenders, examinations, or campus navigation, please let me know!

entries.question: I wnat pledge for eye donation please give me details
entries.answer:
To pledge your eyes for donation at King George's Medical University (KGMU), you can contact the **Department of Ophthalmology**, which manages the Eye Bank and corneal transplantation services. 

Here are the key details and how you can proceed:

- **Department:** Department of Ophthalmology (Cornea & Eye Bank)
- **Main Website:** [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)
- **Eye Bank Contact & OPD Services:** You can visit the Ophthalmology Department located on the campus or contact the KGMU inquiry helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333** to obtain the specific Eye Donation Pledge Form.

**General Information on Eye Pledging:**
- Pledging is a voluntary act and can be done by filling out an eye donation pledge form. 
- It is important to inform your family members about your decision so they can fulfill your wish in the event of your death. 
- Retrieval must ideally be done within 6 hours of passing away.

entries.question: How to book online apointment
entries.answer:

**1. Online Registration System (ORS)**
- Visit the official portal at [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
- Log in or register using your mobile number.
- Select **Uttar Pradesh** as your state and **KGMU** as the hospital.
- Choose **New Appointment**, select the desired department, date, and time slot.
- Enter the patient details and pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee online.
- Download or print the appointment slip.

**2. ABHA / Health Care App**
- Register on the mobile application using your mobile number and OTP.
- Follow the same state and hospital selection flow as above to book your appointment and pay the fee.

**3. SMS Booking**
- Send an SMS in the format `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.

**Important Guidelines:**
- Online registration is mandatory.
- The standard OPD slip fee is ₹50 across booking methods.
- Patients from outside Lucknow must carry a valid referral letter for the specific department.
- For more details, you can contact the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: I want appointment for my child age 5 year for his IQ test referred by Balrampur Hospital
entries.answer:
For scheduling an IQ test appointment for a 5-year-old child referred by Balrampur Hospital, you can visit the **Department of Psychiatry** or the **Department of Clinical Psychology** at King George's Medical University (KGMU). 

Since online OPD registration is mandatory at KGMU, please follow these booking steps:

1. **Online Booking (Recommended):** Register online via the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in) or the ABHA app by selecting Uttar Pradesh and KGMU, choosing the appropriate Department (Pediatric OPD / Psychiatry), paying the ₹50 registration fee, and downloading your OPD slip.
2. **Alternative Methods:** You can also pre-book by sending an SMS (`APPOINTMENT <NAME>`) to **8887019134** or by calling the helpline at **0522-2258880** / **0522-3539333**.
3. **Walk-in:** You can visit the KGMU OPD counter with the child's Aadhaar card and your referral letter from Balrampur Hospital. Please note that registration counters close at 1:00 PM sharp.

**Important Reminders:**
- Bring the original referral letter from Balrampur Hospital along with all previous medical and developmental records of the child.
- OPD timings are Monday to Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM), closed on Sundays and gazetted holidays.

entries.question: Hme opd me dhikhna hai
entries.answer:
To consult a doctor at KGMU OPD, online registration is mandatory. Here are the details and booking methods:

### OPD Timings
- **Monday to Friday:** 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
- **Saturday:** 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM
- **Closed:** Sundays and public holidays
- **OPD Slip Fee:** ₹50
- **Note:** The registration/token counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp. Outside-city patients must bring a valid referral for the specific department. Pre-booking is strongly recommended.

### Booking Methods
1. **Online (ORS):** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) → Select Uttar Pradesh → Select KGMU → Choose New Appointment → Select department and date → Enter patient details → Pay ₹50 → Download the slip.
2. **Mobile App:** Register on the ABHA / National Health Care App using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same hospital selection flow.
3. **SMS:** Send `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Bring your Aadhaar card and active mobile number to the hospital counter to generate a token via OTP, pay ₹50, and collect your OPD slip.

**Helpline & Assistance:**
- Phone: 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333
- For sleep-related or psychological concerns, you can book an appointment under the **Psychiatry** or **Medicine** departments.

entries.question: Booking Kaise KR skte h step wise btaa do
entries.answer:
KGMU OPD में ऑनलाइन या ऑफलाइन बुकिंग करने के लिए निम्नलिखित चरणों का पालन करें:

### बुकिंग के तरीके और स्टेप-वाइज प्रक्रिया:

**1. ऑनलाइन बुकिंग (ORS पोर्टल के माध्यम से)**
* **स्टेप 1:** आधिकारिक वेबसाइट [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाएं या 'ABHA / Health Care App' का उपयोग करें।
* **स्टेप 2:** अपने मोबाइल नंबर और ओटीपी (OTP) के जरिए लॉगिन या रजिस्टर करें।
* **स्टेप 3:** राज्य में **'Uttar Pradesh'** और अस्पताल में **'KGMU'** (King George's Medical University) चुनें।
* **स्टेप 4:** **'New Appointment'** विकल्प पर क्लिक करें और संबंधित विभाग (Department) और उपलब्ध तिथि/समय चुनें।
* **स्टेप 5:** मरीज का विवरण भरें, ₹50 का ऑनलाइन पर्ची शुल्क (OPD slip fee) भुगतान करें।
* **स्टेप 6:** बुकिंग पूरी होने के बाद डिजिटल पर्ची (Slip) डाउनलोड कर लें।

**2. एसएमएस (SMS) द्वारा बुकिंग**
* **स्टेप 1:** अपने मोबाइल से मैसेज में टाइप करें: `Appointment [Patient Name]`
* **स्टेप 2:** इसे **8887019134** पर भेज दें।

**3. वॉक-इन (अस्पताल आकर काउंटर से बुकिंग)**
* **स्टेप 1:** केजीएमयू आएं और काउंटर पर अपना आधार कार्ड और एक्टिव मोबाइल नंबर दें।
* **स्टेप 2:** मोबाइल पर आए ओटीपी (OTP) को सत्यापित करें और फिजिकल टोकन प्राप्त करें।
* **स्टेप 3:** ₹50 का भुगतान करके काउंटर से अपनी OPD पर्ची ले लें। 

*नोट:* 
* ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। भीड़ से बचने के लिए पहले से बुकिंग करना बेहतर है। 
* पर्ची/टिकट काउंटर दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक ही खुला रहता है। 
* शहर से बाहर के मरीजों को संबंधित विभाग के लिए वैध रेफरल (Referral) पत्र लाना अनिवार्य है। 
* अधिक जानकारी के लिए [KGMU वेबसाइट](https://www.kgmu.org) देख सकते हैं।
